14z-62i (maintainer round 2: 'the three medallions don't show at all', both emulators): the record's coordinate pairs are RELATIVE to the wheel drawer object's base, measured (256,176) \u2014 back-computed from Jedah's medallion (pair (-20,-119), OBJ (236,57)) and confirmed on Gallon's 3x3 (pair (8,-112), OBJ (264,64)). The cells' 'pos' values are RING-CENTRE coordinates; the sprite-corner offset for a 3x2 medallion is (-12,-7) (Jedah's empirical). The generator converts: pair = pos + corner_offset - obj_base. The raw positions had been appended verbatim, landing the three entries at OBJ x=480-528/y=344-352 \u2014 emitted every frame, never on screen, invisible to every RAM-basis gate.

14z-63: the ring/highlight drawer ($FFBA00) takes its per-cell base from the 32-row pc-relative word-pair table at PRG:0x5FAE2 (variant half a byte-identical alias of the base half in vsav, exactly like TABLE B; vs2's own variant half is UN-aliased with its newcomers' bases \u2014 this fix replicates Capcom's move). Transform, measured on two independent cases (the misplaced b000 bar; Jedah's row-0x0F ring): OBJ_x = base_x + record_coord_x + 64, OBJ_y = 224 - (base_y + record_coord_y). Bases here derive from the row-0x0F reference (base (192,184), measured ring centre (248,64)): base = (pos_x - 56, 248 - pos_y) \u2014 i.e. a record positioned like Jedah's ring lands centred on this cell's ring-centre 'pos'. The interim composed b000 bar (5x1, coord (-40,-16)) draws ~8px right of centre with these bases; exact bar-centring would use pos_x - 64. Decision pending (maintainer): ring reuse vs bar vs authored art.
